func test_worker_task(arg: *TestTaskArg[ctx]) {
    mut local_ctx := os.Arena.New();
    defer local_ctx.Free();
    os.SetThreadScratch(local_ctx);

    unsafe {
        mut t := (*arg).test;
        mut ok := run_test(local_ctx, t);
        (*arg).chan.Send(ok);
    }
}
